title: (0Day) Docker Desktop cli-plugins Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Docker Desktop for Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to escape the container and execute low-privileged code within the Docker Hyper-V VM in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the the implemention of the Docker cli-plugins functionality. The issue results from incorrect permissions on folders. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code on the host system in the context of the current user.
